title: Return-walk counter coordinate
statement: For an exponential breadth-first-search state $S$, the coordinate at index $11$ of its 17-entry counter vector is its return-walk counter $T_2$; that is, this coordinate equals $S.T_2$.
replaced:
For every state $S$ of the exponential breadth-first search procedure, the
return-walk-counter coordinate of its 17-entry register vector is $S.T2$.
